fee_notes: Royalty 7% of Gross Sales for first 12 months, then greater of 7% of Gross Sales or 7% of Minimum Gross Sales Requirement (beginning month 13). Brand Marketing Fee 2% of Gross Sales beginning month 13. Technology and Software Fee $1,300/month with $650 one-time setup fee; covers software, website/email hosting, up to 4 technician accounts, may include Call Center, franchisor may charge up to 15% administrative fee. Also subject to increases by vendors or franchisor.
raw_excerpt: Royalty: 7% of Gross Sales, for the first 12 months of operation; Beginning in month 13, the greater of 7% of Gross Sales, or 7% of the Minimum Gross Sales Requirement.
